title: xanthoxalis cymosa
intro: Xanthoxalis cymosa, commonly known as Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species in the Oxalis genus, characterized by its yellow flowers and acidic taste. The health benefits of Yellow Wood Sorrel include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. Therapeutically, Xanthoxalis cymosa has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues and skin conditions due to its astringent and anti-inflammatory actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
